tagline.en: A shared geometry-prior interface in WorldFoundry — a common contract for 3D reconstruction and geometry estimation models.
tagline.zh: WorldFoundry 中的共享几何先验接口——面向 3D 重建与几何估计模型的统一契约。

en: Geometry is the shared geometry-prior surface in WorldFoundry: a common pipeline and operator contract that a family of 3D and geometry models can plug into. Geometry priors are models that infer 3D structure from images — depth, point maps, and related reconstruction outputs.

This entry defines the shared interface rather than a single model. Individual upstream priors — such as DUSt3R, Depth Anything, and Metric3D — register as their own catalog entries with their own weights and provenance, but all speak the same contract described here.
In WorldFoundry you use this contract to work with geometry priors for 3D reconstruction and geometry-estimation tasks; pick a specific prior's catalog entry for its concrete weights and details.
zh: Geometry 是 WorldFoundry 中共享的几何先验接口层:一套统一的 pipeline 与算子契约,供一系列 3D 与几何模型接入。几何先验是指从图像中推断 3D 结构的模型——深度、点图,以及相关的重建输出。
本条目定义的是共享接口,而非某个单一模型。各个上游先验——例如 DUSt3R、Depth Anything、Metric3D——各自作为独立的目录条目注册,拥有各自的权重与来源,但都遵循这里描述的同一套契约。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你借助这套契约来使用几何先验完成 3D 重建与几何估计任务;若需要具体权重与细节,请选择某个具体先验的目录条目。

whenToUse.en: Refer to this entry when you want to understand the common interface geometry priors share; use a specific prior's page (DUSt3R, Depth Anything, Metric3D, etc.) to run actual 3D reconstruction or depth estimation.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想了解几何先验共享的统一接口时,参考本条目;要实际运行 3D 重建或深度估计,请使用某个具体先验的页面(如 DUSt3R、Depth Anything、Metric3D 等)。

notFor.en: This is a shared contract, not a standalone runnable model — there are no weights of its own here. For real inference, choose a concrete geometry-prior model.
notFor.zh: 这是共享契约,而非可独立运行的模型——此处没有自带权重。要做真正的推理,请选择一个具体的几何先验模型。
